L_par_hdr_ssvh.why: Solidity always commits sequencerSetVerifyHash = 0 while Go copies the struct field. This is a defect only if some Go producer sets a nonzero value, which is outside M0's scope: it surfaces the premise ssvh = 0 as an intent question for the Morph team.

L_nat_eta2.why: known_limitation_historical: latent and historical — affects only a chain upgraded through reinitializer(2) while LFI < LCI and later reverted into (LFI, LCI]; the replay injects storage to erase CSR, and initialize2's reinitializer(2)/root!=0 domain is not modelled; audit R5.

L_own_txspayload.why: Conditional (whitepaper O36): corrupts a TxsPayloadV2 result only if a caller holds it across a later Append; the in-repo callers (batch_cache.go:1581, verify_local.go:186) consume it immediately. Native validity bound: the Go growth oracle matches the runtime only for allocations <=512 bytes (Go 1.24 size-class table); outside that the facts fallback is wrong (513->576); audit R6.

L_sym_omega.why: conditional: both orders need proof acceptance by the stand-in verifier (proof == 1); the real ZkEvmVerifierV1 rejects that proof; no real-proof schedule; audit R3.
